request.style: English, soul, deep male solo with warm choir, piano, electric bass, drums, guitar, horn section, reverent and powerful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
These are the chiefs of David's mighty men
Together with all Israel they stood
Giving his kingship strong support
To make him king as the LORD had promised

[Chorus]
Eliphal son of Ur is in the list
One of the mighty men who served
Loyal warriors in the royal court
Strengthening the kingdom of the Lord

[Verse]
Ahiam son of Sachar the Hararite
Stood beside the heroes of the land
The brave men who answered the call
To guard the throne with steady hands

[Chorus]
Eliphal son of Ur is in the list
One of the mighty men who served
Loyal warriors in the royal court
Strengthening the kingdom of the Lord

[Bridge]
Jashobeam chief of the officers
Wielded his spear against three hundred
Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite
One of the three mighty men who stood

[Chorus]
Eliphal son of Ur is in the list
One of the mighty men who served
Loyal warriors in the royal court
Strengthening the kingdom of the Lord

[Outro]
Remembered in the record of the days
Eliphal son of Ur in holy praise
